BC_description: The subprocess.pipeStdout(), subprocess.pipeStderr(), and subprocess.pipeAll() methods have been removed and replaced with a unified subprocess.pipe() method. All usages of pipeStdout(), pipeStderr(), and pipeAll() must be refactored to call pipe() instead. The new pipe() method may require specifying the source of the pipe explicitly via a 'from' piping option, depending on previous usage. This change affects only the 'subprocess' class's methods related to process piping.
